edits.english: Rav Naḥman and Rav Sheshet were sitting, and Rav Adda bar Mattana was sitting with them. And they were sitting and saying, concerning the exchange of words between Reish Lakish and Rabbi Elazar: In response to that which Rabbi Elazar said: We have found a precedent for this situation in the case of offerings that are brought after their owners’ death, as they are fit but they do not propitiate God, Reish Lakish should have said to him: These offerings should also be brought and propitiate God with regard to the heirs.
These offerings should also be brought and propitiate God: For the heirs.
